newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QCT says Japan coal prices settled.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QCT says Japan coal prices settled.

text.p: QCT Resources Ltd said on Friday that coal agreements has been reached with Japanese steel mills on prices and tonnages for QCT Resources shipments of coking coals for the Japanese fiscal year 1997 (April-May).
QCT said agreement with the JSM was negotiated for the Central Queensland Coal Associates (CQCA) and Gregory Joint Venturers by The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP).
The average price of hard coking coals to be sold to the Japanese Steel Mills by QCT in the Japan fiscal 1997 year was effectively unchanged from that achieved in 1996.
QCT said prices for some hard coking coals will increase slightly, but prices for weak coking coals and the remaining hard coking coals will remain unchanged or decrease slightly.
It said its share of shipments from the joint venture mines to the JSM will increase by about 20 percent.
